🔑 Could you take over a 2.5–3% mortgage rate?

Assumable mortgages are one of the smartest buyer plays in this market — you inherit the seller's existing low-rate loan instead of financing at today's rates. Savings can be huge over the life of the loan.

Our new hub breaks down:
• How assumability actually works
• Which loan types qualify (VA, FHA, USDA, some conventional)
• What it costs to assume vs. refinance
• The fine print that trips buyers up

Start here: https://saahomes.com/assumable-mortgages/

Deep dives: Colorado assumable guide → https://saahomes.com/blog/assumable-mortgage-colorado/ and Fort Collins assumable homes → https://saahomes.com/blog/assumable-homes-fort-collins/
